agents.name: Claude Code (reviewer)
agents.notes: Runs headless (claude -p --restricted --strict-mcp-config) in an isolated working directory containing only the handoff artifacts. Swap 'command' for a different CLI agent if you want an external reviewer instead.

agents.name: Claude Code (mediator)
agents.notes: Runs headless in an isolated working directory containing the full evidence chain plus findings.md and review.md, and reconciles the two into final-report.md.

reviewProtocol.description: The executor produces evidence and findings, starting barebones -- no MCP servers registered. The reviewer independently examines the same evidence and produces its own findings. The mediator reconciles the two into a cited final report, surfacing disagreements rather than resolving them, before escalating to the human. See config.claude-playwright.example.json for the recipe to add Playwright MCP if a real run needs to branch past a barebones blocker (docs/branching-design.md).
